> Field notes are the single most valuable contribution to this project.
> Even "I ran it and it broke at step 3" is worth more than any
> self-reported benchmark. Thank you. With your permission these go in
> [`docs/field-notes/`](https://github.com/pauti04/CostDNA/tree/main/docs/field-notes).

## What you ran it on

- [ ] Real AWS account (production)
- [ ] Real AWS account (sandbox / non-prod)
- [ ] Azure subscription
- [ ] GCP project
- [ ] Synthetic env only
- [ ] In-browser CUR scan (cost-dna.vercel.app/your-account)

**Account shape:** (rough resource count, team count, current tag
completeness — e.g. "~600 resources, 4 teams, ~50% tagged")

## What worked

Predictions that matched ground truth, tools you found useful, the
moment the inferred tags surfaced something you didn't know.

## What broke

Errors, surprising behaviour, missing features, where the docs let you
down, resource types it couldn't handle.

## Honest reaction

Would you run it again? Recommend it? What's the single biggest gap
between current state and "I'd use this monthly"?

## Permission to credit

- [ ] You may quote this (anonymized) in the README / field-notes
- [ ] You may use my name / company
- [ ] Keep this private — for the maintainer's eyes only
